## Install

```sh
npm install -g github:arjunpundeer7/diorama
diorama preview
```

## Downloads

- **diorama-extension-*.zip**: the browser extension for claude.ai and chatgpt.com. Unzip it, open `chrome://extensions`, turn on Developer mode and choose Load unpacked.
- **diorama-vscode-*.vsix**: the editor extension for VS Code, Cursor and Windsurf. In the Extensions view, choose Install from VSIX, then run **diorama: Apply Theme**.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/arjunpundeer7/diorama/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what changed.
